input.summary: Reset 21.1 cap basis to the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000, and widen 21.3's payment carve-out to amounts due
input.comment: [Playbook] "Fees" is defined as only the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form, so the cap is illusory; we have reset limb (a) to the fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement in the 12 months preceding the claim and added the USD 1,000,000 limb. In 21.3 we widen the payment carve-out to amounts due under this Agreement so Customer's payment obligations, not just the Implementation Fee, sit outside the cap.

ops.oldText: each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
ops.newText: each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) the fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement in the 12 months preceding the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000.

ops.oldText: pay undisputed Fees for conforming Services is not damages and is not limited by this Section.
ops.newText: pay amounts due under this Agreement is not damages and is not limited by this Section.
